sections.label: OTC commodity derivatives regulation transfer
sections.summary: IE Singapore will transfer regulation of OTC commodity derivatives contracts under the CTA to MAS for single-agency oversight.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: With the passing of the Securities and Futures (Amendment) Bill 2016 this year, IE Singapore will also be transferring the regulation of OTC commodity derivatives contracts under the CTA to MAS, for more effective regulatory oversight under a single agency.

sections.label: IE Singapore commodity trading functions
sections.summary: The Bill amends the IESBA to limit IE Singapore's commodity trading regulation to spot commodity trading and the rubber trade industry.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: As physical commodity trading is not the regulatory domain under MAS, regulatory oversight over such activities will remain with IE Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: This Bill proposes amendments to the IESBA to align IE Singapore's regulatory functions over the commodity trading industry with the reduced scope of the CTA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: First, the IESBA will be amended to reflect that IE Singapore's regulatory function over the commodity trading industry will be limited to spot commodity trading and the rubber trade industry.

sections.label: Singapore Rubber Fund purposes update
sections.summary: An administrative amendment will update the purposes for which the Singapore Rubber Fund may be used, reflecting IE Singapore's revised functions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: In addition to these key amendments, there will also be an administrative amendment to update the purposes for which the Singapore Rubber Fund (SRF) may be used, to take into account the revised functions of IE Singapore.

sections.label: Rubber trade regulation and promotion
sections.summary: IE Singapore will continue to administer the RIA, review the Act periodically, and promote Singapore's rubber trade and industry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The regulations under the RIA, which includes licensing of rubber traders and dealing, shipping and treatment of natural rubber, have served the industry well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: IE Singapore will continue to administer the RIA and will conduct periodic reviews of the Act.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: IE Singapore will also continue to work in promoting the growth of the rubber trade and industry in Singapore.

sections.label: Clarity on IE Singapore functions
sections.summary: The proposed IESBA amendments provide better clarity on IE Singapore's regulatory functions given the reduced CTA scope.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The proposed amendments to the IESBA will provide better clarity on IE Singapore's regulatory functions in view of the reduced scope of the CTA.
